narrative.overview:
Every public surface of brag.fast opens inside a photograph. The still is the product: a synthetic golden-hour breakfast scene runs edge to edge, bright, with no wash over it. Type sits on the photo the way a title is painted onto a sleeve. The wordmark is paint — a hand-brushed raster at `/wordmark.png` with bubblegum-to-tangerine baked into the strokes — not a costume gradient on a geometric font.

The world is warm light on a cool base. The photographs carry the tangerine hour; the page around them is a cold, pale sky-white (foam) so the warmth stays inside the frame. Ink is deep indigo (night), never black. The candy set is the only saturated UI: bubblegum flare, tangerine citrus, sun yellow, sky blue, mint. Flare fading into citrus is the brand's one gradient. It is baked into the painted wordmark, and it fills pressed-on objects (primary button, active candy key, rank burst). It is never applied as CSS gradient-text. Rank is a rotated 12-point flash sticker, not a table row and not a circle.

Density is generous and rounded. Controls are 3D candy keys, panels are 28px-radius slabs, spacing runs on a loose 4px rhythm with wide section gaps. Dutch is the default UI language; the atmosphere stamp reads **Sfeerbeeld**. Confirmed anti-references: cream and maple surfaces, the Syne display face, `.flare-text` on geometric fonts, full-bleed indigo hero overlays, circular rank badges, and directory-style cards where a thumbnail is boxed beside a text column.
keyCharacteristics: Photo-first: hero, city and spot headers are full-bleed stills with no overlay; copy uses local text-shadow so the still stays bright.
Wordmark is a painted raster (`/wordmark.png`), used in the hero and the header. No CSS gradient-text.
Cool ground, warm subject: foam and white surfaces; the heat lives in the photography and the candy accents.
One gradient, pressed-on only: flare → citrus on the painted wordmark, the primary button, the active candy key, and the rank burst.
Indigo ink on light surfaces; solid white Lilita One with photo-copy on photographs.
Candy keys for filters and segments (sky / mint / sun at rest, flare → citrus when pressed); 28px slabs for content.
Two display voices: Lilita One for shouted titles; Pacifico only for `#bragfast` signatures.

rules.name: The Warm Inside the Frame Rule
rules.body: Warm colour comes from the photograph and the candy accents. Page grounds and panels are foam or white; no beige, cream or maple surface exists in this system.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The only gradient is flare → citrus, top to bottom. It is baked into `/wordmark.png` and fills pressed-on objects (primary button, active candy key, rank burst). Do not invent a second gradient, reverse this one, or apply it as CSS gradient-text.

rules.name: The Indigo Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is night, never `#000`. Night at alpha tints the header, borders, and a short card-foot fade. It does not wash the hero.

rules.name: The Sun Points the Way Rule
rules.body: On any night or photographic ground, links and focus rings are sun. Flare is for selected state, not for links.

rules.name: The Paint, Not Costume Rule
rules.body: The wordmark is a painted raster. Never apply a CSS gradient to a geometric display face and call it the wordmark.

rules.name: The Painted Title Rule
rules.body: A title on a photograph is Lilita One in solid white with `.photo-copy`, placed bottom-left. It is never boxed in a caption bar and never filled with flare → citrus.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headlines are not preceded by a small uppercase kicker. The hashtag `#bragfast` is a brand signature in the header and footer, not a label above content.

rules.name: The Two Shouts Rule
rules.body: Lilita One shouts names. Pacifico signs `#bragfast` only. Body copy, labels and controls are always Figtree.

rules.name: The Still First Rule
rules.body: No public page starts with a heading on a flat ground. The first viewport is a photograph with the title and, on home, the search pill placed on it.

rules.name: The Photo-Copy Rule
rules.body: Legibility on a bright still comes from local text-shadow (`.photo-copy`), never from a full-bleed indigo overlay.

rules.name: The Coloured Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with the thing casting them: flare under flare objects, night under white, photographic, or candy-key objects. No grey or black shadow.

rules.name: The Candy Key Rule
rules.body: Filters and segments are 3D keys. The night-tinted foot is how a key sits on the desk. Do not flatten them into white-bordered chips and do not read the foot as a card side-tab.

rules.name: The Pill or Slab Rule
rules.body: If a user can press it, it is a pill (and if it is a filter or segment, it is a candy key). If it holds content, it is a 28px slab. Rank is a burst. Nothing else.

rules.name: The Burst Rank Rule
rules.body: Board rank is a rotated 12-point flare → citrus burst with a zero-padded Lilita number. Never a circle, never a table index.

dos: Do open every public page with a full-bleed still pulled under the translucent night header, title bottom-left in white Lilita with `.photo-copy`.
Do use the painted `/wordmark.png` in the hero and the header.
Do use flare → citrus only on the painted wordmark, the primary button, the active candy key, and the rank burst.
Do make filters and segments 3D candy keys (sky / mint / sun at rest) and every content container a 28px slab.
Do mark spot cards with the city still plus a sun Sfeerbeeld/Atmosphere stamp; put rank in a rotated 12-point burst.
Do show maker name and time on every brag card; keep seed placeholder images in the DOM as `sr-only` behind a sky fallback.
Do put the back-to-city link below the spot address.
Do use sun for links and focus rings on photographs and night grounds; flare for selected state.
Do keep body copy, labels and controls in Figtree; Lilita One shouts names; Pacifico signs `#bragfast` only.
Do keep the page ground foam and panels white so the photograph stays the warmest thing on screen.
donts: Don't introduce cream, beige or maple surfaces, or bring back Syne.
Don't restore `.flare-text` or put a CSS gradient on Lilita, Pacifico, or any geometric display face.
Don't wash a hero, city or spot still with a full-bleed indigo overlay.
Don't treat spot cards as venue photography; they are city stills with an atmosphere stamp.
Don't draw rank as a circle or a table number.
Don't flatten candy keys into white-bordered chips.
Don't box a thumbnail beside a text column; a list item is a photo with the title painted on it.
Don't put a small uppercase kicker above a headline.
Don't use `#000` for text or fades; ink is night.
Don't add a second gradient, reverse the flare → citrus direction, or use citrus as a flat button fill.
Don't use grey or black drop shadows, or borders to fake elevation.
Don't hide maker name or time on a brag card.
